scripts.dev:web:https: wrangler pages dev public --ip 127.0.0.1 --port 8788 --local-protocol https --log-level warn
scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply fox-referrals --local --config wrangler.worker.jsonc --persist-to .wrangler/local
scripts.db:seed:local: wrangler d1 execute fox-referrals --local --config wrangler.worker.jsonc --file seeds/local.sql --persist-to .wrangler/local
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
